title: Integrals over a frame box in frame coordinates
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) be an orthonormal family with span G, r ∈ ℝ, H^k := μHE[k], and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be any function. Put Q := {t ∈ G : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r for all i} and I := {u ∈ ℝ^k (u : Fin k → ℝ) : |u_i| ≤ r for all i}, with Lebesgue measure volume on Fin k → ℝ. Then ∫_Q f dH^k = ∫_I f(Σ_i u_i·g_i) du.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ g → ∫ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, f t ∂μHE[k] = ∫ u in {u : Fin k → ℝ | ∀ i, |u i| ≤ r}, f (∑ i, u i • g i)
